note: Example data: an invented online shop for wall art prints and frames with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. Pinterest Trends rows are invented too, and every payload is a draft marked 'not run'.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "pinterest-organic-manager" skill. Review my Pinterest account, show me my best pins and boards, and plan my next pins from Pinterest Trends. We sell wall art prints and frames online; use the home_decor interest. Then turn our gallery wall layouts post into a pin and draft a board for holiday wall art.

date_range: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-27 (last 30 complete days), compared with 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-27
data_pulled: get_board_pins for each board (28 pins) and get_board_sections (5 sections)
get_user_account_analytics: the window and the previous 30 days, with PIN_FORMAT, APP_TYPE, SOURCE and OWNED_CONTENT splits for the window
